# Volume 1 timeline

## CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised

**[Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) spots a dressed-up [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) leaving [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) in his buggy, sparking her intense curiosity. She visits [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to investigate and learns that the [Cuthberts](../codex/factions.md#cuthberts) are adopting an orphan boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), a decision Mrs. Rachel strongly disapproves of and warns [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) against.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P25](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0025)_

## CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised

**[Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) travels to the [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station to pick up an expected orphan boy, only to discover a chatterbox orphan girl waiting for him instead. Unable to explain the mistake, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) decides to take her along in his buggy, finding himself surprisingly charmed by her imaginative talking.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027)_

**[Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Spencer](../character/spencer.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) drives the young girl through the scenic [Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue) and past Barry's pond as she chatters poetically and renames her surroundings. They pass Lynde's Hollow and finally arrive at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) feeling increasingly anxious about the impending disappointment awaiting her.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P44](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0044), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P54](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0054), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P74](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0074), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P77](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0077)_

## CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) brings [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is shocked to discover that an orphan girl was sent instead of a boy. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) bursts into tears upon realizing she is not wanted, but stays for supper and is put to bed in the east gable room. Afterward, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) insists on sending [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back, while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) quietly suggests keeping her.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P52](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0052)_

## CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), Snow Queen** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and admires the surrounding landscape from her window before being told by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to dress and come down for breakfast. After eating with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and a quiet [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) washes the dishes and names Marilla's geranium Bonny. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) then prepares to drive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) over to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) to settle her return arrangements.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P1](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P8](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P19](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P27](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0027)_

## CHAPTER V. Anne’s History

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — As [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) drives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) down the shore road toward [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), she prompts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to share her history. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) describes her orphaned childhood and years of hard labor with Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) and Mrs. [Hammond](../character/hammond.md) before being placed in the asylum. Listening between the lines, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) begins to feel pity for Anne's starved life and considers whether she might keep her after all.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021)_

## CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Blewett](../character/blewett.md), [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Spencer](../character/spencer.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visit Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md) to clarify the adoption mix-up, where Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md) offers to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in as a servant. Seeing Anne's distress and disliking Mrs. Blewett's harsh nature, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hesitates and decides to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back home to consult [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). Later at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay with them, resolving to raise her properly.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P12](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031)_

## CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bed and instructs her on neatness and saying bedtime prayers. After finding out [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has never prayed, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) has her improvise a prayer, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) recites in an unorthodox manner. Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes down to the kitchen and complains to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) about Anne's lack of religious upbringing, resolving to educate her.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P1](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P4](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P21](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P28](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0028)_

## CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) have decided to keep her at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), sending [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) into emotional tears of relief. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) instructs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to memorize the Lord's Prayer, sending her up to her room after several conversations about imagination and potential friends.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P6](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P53](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0053)_

## CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to meet [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), but offends her with blunt remarks about her red hair and looks. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flies into a fiery rage, shouting at Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) before storming off to her bedroom. After Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) leaves in huff, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upstairs and orders her to remain in her room until she agrees to apologize.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P47](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0047)_

## CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room and persuades her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) so she can leave her punishment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dramatically apologizes to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who forgives her completely and gives her flowers. As [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walk back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels a warm surge of affection for the girl despite her theatrical nature.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P50](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0050)_

## CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rogerson](../character/rogerson.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with three plain new dresses, to Anne's disappointment over their lack of puffed sleeves. The following morning, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stays home sick while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decorates her hat with flowers and attends Sunday-school alone, where she feels out of place in Miss Rogerson's class. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) a candid review of her day, the lesson, and the church service.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P1](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P9](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P21](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0021)_

## CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for decorating her hat with flowers at church before taking her to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). In the garden, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) quickly hit it off and vow to be lifelong bosom friends. After returning home overjoyed, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a sweet gift of chocolates from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P1](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P42](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0042)_

## CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comes inside late after talking to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and excitedly asks [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) if she can attend the upcoming Sunday-school picnic. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to bake her a basket for the event, which prompts a warm caress from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends the rest of the week enthusiastically dreaming about the picnic and admiring Marilla's amethyst brooch.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P7](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P9](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P11](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0011)_

## CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) accuses [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) of taking her missing amethyst brooch and confines her to her room, causing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to invent a false confession in a desperate attempt to attend the picnic. When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers the brooch snagged on her own shawl, she realizes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was innocent and sends her to the picnic. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home overjoyed after a wonderful day and recounts the picnic events to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P35](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P56](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0056), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P62](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0062), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits her mistake, forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for the false confession, and sends her off to the picnic. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home overjoyed after a wonderful time and tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) all about the events, including ice cream and a boat ride. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) later recounts the entire incident to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), reflecting on Anne's unique nature.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P62](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0062), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P67](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0067), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P69](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0069)_

## CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Tillie Boulter](../character/tillie-boulter.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school together, discussing their classmates and the return of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). During afternoon lessons, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) pulls Anne's braid and calls her 'Carrots,' prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to smash her slate over his head in fury. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand in front of the class, and she furiously refuses Gilbert's apology after school.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Tillie Boulter](../character/tillie-boulter.md)** — After Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) forces [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) as punishment for being late, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) packs up her things and refuses to return to school. Upon Mrs. Rachel Lynde's advice, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) allows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to stay home and study on her own, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) continues to hold a fierce grudge against [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) while imagining a tragic future without [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P81](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0081), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P96](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0096)_

## CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) leaves [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at home for the afternoon and allows her to invite [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) over for tea and raspberry cordial. After spending time in the orchard, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) unknowingly serves [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) three glasses of Marilla's homemade currant wine instead of cordial, causing [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to become dizzy and sick. The next day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) believes she purposefully got [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk and has forbidden them from playing together.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P7](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P25](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P35](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tearfully explains to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) accused her of making [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to check the pantry and realize [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) mistakenly served currant wine instead of raspberry cordial. After [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) fails to persuade Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) personally begs Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for forgiveness, but she is cold and refuses to let [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) play with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) again. A distraught [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) quietly softens with sympathy as she checks on the sleeping child later that night.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. ## CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share a dramatic, tearful farewell near the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble) after Diana's mother forbids them from playing together. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) informs [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) of their permanent separation and decides to return to school, where her classmates welcome her back. Despite the forced estrangement from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) channels her energy into her studies, engaging in a intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P14](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)_

## CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md)** — When [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) comes down with severe croup while her parents are away, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for help. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) uses her past experience with twins to nurse [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) through the night until [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) brings a doctor, earning Mrs. Barry's gratitude and restoring [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Diana's friendship.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) has forgiven her and invited her over to visit [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) excitedly rushes off to the Barrys' house and returns later to joyfully share all the details of her reconciliation and afternoon with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P46](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0046), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md), [Sam](../character/sam.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), with Matthew's help, to let her go to a [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert and spend the night at Diana's house. After enjoying the concert and driving with Diana's cousins, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) race into the spare-room bed only to leap on top of Diana's sleeping [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), who becomes furious.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P9](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P27](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P48](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0048), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P58](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0058)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — After discussing her predicament with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to apologize directly to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for jumping into her bed. Anne's honest confession and earnest defense of [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) win over Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), who laughs, agrees to forgive [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and decides to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after all.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P66](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0066), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P79](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0079), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. ## CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on her first year at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds her for a few minor household blunders. When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) asks her to fetch an apron pattern from the Barrys', [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) confesses her terrifying imaginary hauntings in the spruce wood. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forces [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk through the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood) in the dark to break her of the delusion.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P10](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P12](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P25](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XX. ## CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Allan](../character/allan.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — After preparing a lavish tea for the new minister, Mr. Allan, and his wife, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) serve their guests at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). However, when Mrs. Allan and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) taste Anne's special layer cake, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) immediately demands to know what [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) put in it.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P29](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P31](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P35](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. **[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) beautifully decorates the tea table for Mr. and Mrs. Allan's visit, and even [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) is persuaded to join them. However, when Mrs. Allan tries Anne's cake, they discover that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally flavored it with anodyne liniment instead of vanilla. Mortified, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flees to her room, but Mrs. Allan kindly comforts her and invites her to show off her flower garden.

## CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) thrilled to receive an invitation to tea with Mrs. Allan at the manse. ## CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), [Superintendent Bell](../character/superintendent-bell.md)** — At Diana's party, [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) dares [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts the dare, loses her balance, and falls, breaking her ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) carries her home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes how deeply she cares for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and the doctor puts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on several weeks of bed rest.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. She enthusiastically shares her school activities and Miss Stacy's project for a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) dismisses the concert as nonsense, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) offers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) warm encouragement.

After an awkward attempt to shop himself, he enlists Mrs. Lynde's help to make a brown gloria dress with puffed sleeves. On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed to receive the dress from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and a pair of kid slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), making her concert night a resounding success.

## CHAPTER XXVII. Vanity and Vexation of Spirit

**[Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home to find that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has bought hair dye from a traveling peddler and accidentally turned her red hair green. When washing fails to remove the dye, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) has to cut Anne's hair off completely. ## CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid

[Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rescues her in his dory, but when he asks to be friends, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) coldly refuses him. Afterward, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for the dangerous mishap, though [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) privately encourages her not to give up all her romance.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) bid [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) goodbye after enjoying their stay, with [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) reflecting fondly on Anne's presence. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive home to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a warm welcome and hot supper from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

## CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to propose organizing an advanced class to prepare students for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agree to support Anne's joining the class, which delights [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). The Queen's class is formed, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels saddened by Diana's absence and finds herself in an intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) while privately regretting her past grudge against him.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — School finishes for the term, and Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) reassures her students that she will return next year to prepare them for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) packs away her books to enjoy her summer vacation. Meanwhile, [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), noting Matthew's health issues and commending [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) on how well [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has grown up.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. **[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a relaxing summer outdoors following a doctor's advice before returning to her studies under Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). As the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations approach, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notices how much [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has grown and matured both physically and mentally.

## CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes over to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to tell [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) the thrilling news that she tied for first place on the entrance examination pass list. Overjoyed, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) runs into the field to share her triumph with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who all praise her achievement.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P38](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P40](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. ## CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Evans](../character/evans.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress for a benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) offering pragmatic advice before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves with [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md). At the hotel, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) suffers from severe stage fright upon facing the sophisticated crowd and accomplished performers. However, after spotting [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the audience, she finds her determination, delivers a successful recitation, gets encored, and is warmly praised by the guests.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P4](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P10](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. **[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Evans](../character/evans.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives an encore performance at the concert to avoid disappointing [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), winning over the audience and guests. Afterward, she, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) share supper and reflect on the evening as [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) drives them home, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) expressing contentment with her own life over rich lifestyles.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P38](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. ## CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares to leave for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), sharing an emotional moment with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) before departing [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). After arriving in town, she starts her classes alongside her [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) peers and copes with initial homesickness in her boarding house, where visits from [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and Ruby reveal that an Avery scholarship is available.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P0](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P10](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. ## CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Emily](../character/emily.md), [Frank Stockley](../character/frank-stockley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) adjusts to life at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), forming a close group of ambitious friends and continuing her friendly academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She frequently visits [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) and stays focused on her studies. As examinations approach in the spring, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her philosophical mindset with her classmates while they anxiously prepare for tests and discuss commencement attire.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. ## CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers she has won the Avery scholarship, while [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal, and she attends the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) commencement with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). She returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the summer, reconnecting with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and learning about Gilbert's plans to teach instead of attending college. The next day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) notices Matthew's failing health and Marilla's trouble with her eyes, ending her evening with a quiet walk and affectionate conversation with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P7](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. ## CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Martin](../character/martin.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Spencer](../character/spencer.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) collapses and dies suddenly after reading news of the bank failure. Friends and neighbors gather at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) share their deep grief together. Following the funeral, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) continues processing her sorrow with Mrs. Allan and sits with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who speaks of her upcoming eye exam and past romance with John Blythe.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. ## CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learns she must give up reading and sewing to save her eyesight, leading her to consider selling [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives up her scholarship to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) to stay home, teach at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) surrenders the position for her, and save the farm. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) finally reconcile their rivalry, becoming close friends as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) embraces her new future.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P4](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII.
